caption_recommended:
some people bring peace.
aachu brings plot.

"mujhe kuch nahi hua" means something definitely happened.
one plan becomes twelve backup plans.

and somehow, zuv makes all of it feel safe.
caption_alt: Maybe love is not less chaos. Maybe it is safer chaos.

Illustrated carousel slide 3: Aachu sits on an overflowing suitcase with clothes, bangles, and one sandal visible; Zuv patiently tries to zip it closed.
